About the Role

Danfoss is seeking a Technical Support Engineer Graduate to join Danfoss Arabia in Riyadh. This full-time position is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are passionate about energy efficiency and solving technical challenges within sustainable cooling solutions. The role focuses on contributing to the growth, development, and technical enhancement for customers across Saudi Arabia.
Role Context and Impact

As a Technical Support Engineer Graduate within Danfoss Climate Solutions, you will apply engineering theory to real-world products. This position offers exposure to industry-leading technologies and aims to improve energy efficiency, reliability, and performance in critical cooling applications. These applications include data centers, commercial HVAC, industrial process cooling, and cold rooms, among others.
Key Responsibilities
• Support the specification, selection, and troubleshooting of compressors, line components, and electronic controllers across HVAC/R applications.
• Provide technical guidance and solutions to customers and end-users, addressing product and application inquiries.
• Deliver technical presentations and training sessions to support customer understanding and product adoption.
• Document testing results, technical findings, and recommendations through clear and accurate reports.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to support product improvements and new product development initiatives.
Qualifications and Experience
• 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field.
• A passion for energy efficiency and solving technical challenges.
Work Environment and Development

Danfoss promotes internal growth and supports learning through mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities. Employees are provided with flexibility, autonomy, and support to perform their best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. The company is committed to creating an inclusive work environment where individuals from all backgrounds are respected and valued.

Jobs@mmppf.com

مع كتابة المسمى الوظيفي (مهندس دعم فني) في عنوان البريد الإلكتروني.

نبذة عن الدور

تبحث الجامعة العربية المفتوحة عن اخصائي دعم فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان سير العمل التقني بسلاسة من خلال إدارة الأجهزة والأنظمة وتقديم الدعم الفني للمستخدمين. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الدعم الفني.
المسؤوليات الرئيسية
• وضع المواصفات الفنية للأجهزة الجديدة، واستلامها والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المحددة.
• توثيق جميع الأجهزة وملحقاتها داخل المؤسسة، وتسجيل المشاكل التقنية اليومية التي تطرأ عليها.
• إجراء الصيانة الدورية والوقائية اللازمة للأجهزة لضمان كفاءتها.
• الإجابة على استفسارات المستخدمين المتعلقة بالمشاكل التقنية، وتقديم الحلول الممكنة أو توجيههم إلى الجهات المختصة.
• التحقق من حالة الأنظمة والتأكد من احتوائها على البرامج المطلوبة مثل أنظمة التشغيل، وتحويل الأعطال الكبيرة إلى الموردين أو مسؤولي الصيانة.
• إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية، والعمل على تطوير أساليب العمل باستخدام أحدث التقنيات المتاحة.
المؤهلات والخبرات
• خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الدعم الفني أو ما يعادله.
• فهم جيد لمواصفات الأجهزة والأنظمة التشغيلية.
• القدرة على تشخيص وحل المشاكل التقنية بفعالية.
المهارات المطلوبة
• مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وتقديم الدعم للمستخدمين.
• القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية بدقة.
• مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على توثيق المعلومات.
• القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق.
بيئة العمل

هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في حائل، وتقدم فرصة للعمل ضمن بيئة أكاديمية داعمة في الجامعة العربية المفتوحة.
معلومات إضافية

الراتب لهذه الوظيفة لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على التقديم لهذه الفرصة للمساهمة في دعم البنية التحتية التقنية للجامعة.

About the Role

Virtucruit is collaborating with a prominent mining company in Saudi Arabia to recruit a Technical Support Specialist for their Drilling Department. This full-time position is based in Najran and requires 2-5 years of experience in technical support.
Role Purpose and Context

The Technical Support Specialist will be responsible for providing essential technical support, troubleshooting, and resolving operational issues related to drilling systems, equipment, and technologies. This role is crucial for ensuring smooth drilling operations and minimizing downtime within a demanding mining environment.
Key Responsibilities
• Provide technical support to drilling and site personnel.
• Install and configure hardware and software systems.
• Troubleshoot IT equipment, network, and system issues.
• Support field data collection devices and systems.
• Maintain IT equipment inventory and asset tracking.
• Respond promptly to user service requests.
• Ensure systems are updated and properly maintained.
• Monitor network performance and connectivity.
• Assist in the setup of site communication systems.
• Ensure compliance with cybersecurity measures.
• Maintain documentation of IT systems and issues.
• Support remote sites with connectivity solutions.
• Install upgrades and patches as required.
• Provide user training on IT systems.
• Assist in backup and data recovery processes.
• Coordinate with vendors for technical support.
• Ensure compliance with IT policies and procedures.
• Maintain helpdesk records and issue logs.
• Support continuous improvement of IT services.
• Perform other duties assigned by management.
Qualifications and Experience
• Diploma or Degree in IT or a related field.
• Minimum of 2 years of technical support experience.
Required Skills
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Knowledge of hardware, software, and networking principles.
• Good communication and customer service skills.
• Basic English communication skills.
Application Process

This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the reliability and efficiency of drilling operations. Salary information will be disclosed during the interview process.

job_title: Unified Communication (Senior Technical Support Engineer) - Saudi National
job_description:
We are looking for an experienced Unified Communications (UC) Expert to design, implement, and manage enterprise-grade Unified Communications infrastructure, including IVR, voice, video, and collaboration solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in UC platforms, telephony systems, IVR integration, and VoIP technologies, ensuring reliable, secure, and high-performing communication services.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, implement, and maintain Unified Communications infrastructure supporting IVR, voice, video, and collaboration services.
• Lead the technical design, deployment, and integration of IVR solutions with UC platforms and contact center applications.
• Configure and manage call flows, call routing, session management, voice gateways, PBX systems, and Session Border Controllers (SBCs).
• Integrate IVR systems with CRM platforms, C2M databases, and other enterprise applications.
• Optimize UC infrastructure for performance, scalability, high availability, redundancy, and disaster recovery.
• Conduct interoperability testing across UC platforms, endpoints, gateways, and IVR applications.
• Troubleshoot complex UC, telephony, VoIP, and IVR issues, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.
• Monitor system health, call quality, service availability, and performance using monitoring and reporting tools.
• Support deployment activities, system upgrades, configuration changes, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
• Implement voice network design best practices, including Quality of Service (QoS), capacity planning, and failover mechanisms.
• Ensure compliance with telecom standards, VoIP protocols, and security best practices.
• Collaborate with network, infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure seamless integration across enterprise systems.

Required Skills and Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
• 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Unified Communications, enterprise telephony, and voice infrastructure.
• Strong expertise in UC platforms such as Cisco, Avaya, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Webex.
• Proven experience implementing, integrating, and supporting IVR-enabled Unified Communications solutions.
• Strong understanding of IVR architecture, call flows, and integration with voice and contact center platforms.
• Proficiency in SIP, RTP, SBCs, voice gateways, PBX systems, and call routing configurations.
• Experience in voice network architecture, QoS, high availability, redundancy, and disaster recovery.
• Knowledge of CRM integration, C2M databases, and contact center applications.
• Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization skills.
• Experience with UC monitoring, reporting, and performance management tools.
• Good understanding of VoIP protocols, telecom standards, and communication security practices.

Preferred Certifications
• Cisco CCIE Collaboration
• Avaya ACIS
• Microsoft Teams / Skype for Business certifications
• Genesys Certified Professional
